content.rpt_battery_2025#s1: Overview of the European battery market in 2025. Market concentration increased.
content.rpt_battery_2025#s2: Market share 2025: Voltacell 31.4%, Nordbatt 22.7%, Lumion 14.2%, Ferrix 9.8%, Kestrel Energy 6.1%.
content.rpt_battery_2025#s3: Methodology: shipments in GWh, 41 plants surveyed. Full ranking: Voltacell 31.4%, Nordbatt 22.7%, Lumion 14.2%, Ferrix 9.8%, Kestrel Energy 6.1%, Others 15.8%.
content.rpt_battery_2025#s4: Production volumes: Voltacell Gdansk 48.3 GWh, Nordbatt Skelleftea 36.9 GWh, Lumion Metz 21.6 GWh.
content.rpt_lithium_costs_2025#s1: Average lithium carbonate cost per tonne: 2021 7,412 USD, 2022 9,138 USD, 2023 8,264 USD, 2024 6,977 USD, 2025 6,415 USD.
content.rpt_lithium_costs_2025#s2: Cost per tonne 2025: Chile 5,820 USD, Australia 7,145 USD, Argentina 6,033 USD, China 6,874 USD.
content.rpt_gigafactory_2025#s1: Installed capacity: Gdansk 52.5 GWh, Skelleftea 40.2 GWh, Metz 24.8 GWh, Salzgitter 19.6 GWh.
content.rpt_gigafactory_2025#s2: Forecast 2030 capacity 612.7 GWh, CAGR 27.3%. Methodology: announced projects weighted by financing stage.
content.rpt_recycling_2025#s1: Recycling rate 2025: Germany 61.2%, France 54.9%, Poland 38.4%, Spain 41.7%.
content.page_internal_notes: Internal: client Atlas Capital pays 18,500 EUR retainer. Draft margin 43.6%.
